name: Softr
description_en:
Softr assembles portals and internal tools from connected data, user groups, pages and actions. It includes native database and workflow capabilities alongside external data sources, so evaluation should start with the chosen source and the user’s allowed operations.

Its permissions and automation layers require explicit configuration. Global restrictions default to unrestricted behavior, conditional group membership behaves differently from manual assignment, and workflow preview does not cover every control step. Test a small portal under real role combinations before relying on a visual preview.
description_zh:
Softr 基于连接数据、用户组、页面及动作搭建门户和内部工具，同时提供原生数据库、工作流及外部数据源。评估应从所选来源和用户允许的操作开始。

权限与自动化层需要明确配置。全局限制默认不加限制，条件入组与手动分配的行为不同，工作流预览也不覆盖所有控制步骤。应按真实角色组合测试小型门户，再判断可视化预览是否足够。

core_features.name_zh: 基于用户组的数据限制
core_features.explanation_en: Apply table-level view/create/edit/delete restrictions to selected groups, with deny precedence.
core_features.explanation_zh: 对所选组施加表级查看／创建／编辑／删除限制，禁止规则优先。

core_features.explanation_en: App actions, database events, webhooks and schedules can trigger mapped actions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 应用动作、数据库事件、webhook 及计划可触发数据映射后的动作。

core_features.explanation_en: Preview user roles and device sizes, then republish changes to the live application.
core_features.explanation_zh: 预览用户角色和设备尺寸，再重新发布以更新正式应用。

en: Evaluate a client portal that limits each client to its records.
Pilot an approval workflow with a rejected branch and bounded loop.
zh: 评估仅允许客户访问自身记录的门户。
试点带拒绝分支及有限循环的审批流程。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Use synthetic source records and overlapping test groups to verify deny behavior, including Comments separately.
steps.zh: 使用模拟来源记录和重叠测试组验证禁止规则，单独核对 Comments。

steps.en: Generate a sample event, inspect each workflow path, publish and retest the live URL under two roles.
steps.zh: 生成样例事件，检查各工作流路径，发布后用两个角色复测正式 URL。

items.en: Global restrictions do not currently cover the Comments block.
items.zh: 全局限制目前不覆盖 Comments 模块。

items.en: Nested loops increase action usage for every item combination.
items.zh: 嵌套循环按每种项目组合增加动作消耗。

pricing.summary_en: The actual homepage FAQ gives annual-billed monthly equivalents of Free $0, Basic $19, Pro $99 and Business $329, plus custom Enterprise. The formal /pricing read returned only a footer. Usage quotas, connector tiers and write-restriction entitlements require plan-specific confirmation; no checkout total was established.
pricing.summary_zh: 实际首页 FAQ 给出年付折算月价：Free $0、Basic $19、Pro $99、Business $329，Enterprise 定制。正式 /pricing 读取仅有页脚。用量、连接器层级及写入限制需按方案核对，未确认结账总额。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Configure data rules before adding users
sections.title_zh: 添加用户前先配置数据规则
sections.en: Without global restrictions, users can perform available operations unless local controls restrict them. Rules target a source table and one or more groups, with Can’t taking precedence when groups conflict. Comments is explicitly excluded from global restrictions. Include that block separately in the access review.
sections.zh: 未配置全局限制时，用户可执行可用操作，除非局部控制另有限制。规则针对来源表及一个或多个组，冲突时 Can’t 优先。Comments 明确不在全局限制覆盖内，应单独检查该模块访问。

sections.title_en: View and write restrictions have different tiers
sections.title_zh: 查看与写入限制对应不同层级
sections.en: The restriction guide makes View available on all plans, including Free, but places Create/Edit/Delete restrictions on Business and above. Match the required operation to its entitlement rather than assuming that a visible form or working list proves the intended write restriction is available.
sections.zh: 限制指南说明 View 在包括 Free 的全部方案可用，Create／Edit／Delete 限制则要求 Business 或更高。应逐项匹配所需操作及权益，不能通过可见表单或正常列表推定目标写入限制可用。

sections.title_zh: 条件用户组由规则决定
sections.en: Membership can be assigned manually or by user attributes. A user added through a condition cannot simply be removed manually; adjust the condition instead. Group changes require publishing to take effect. Review overlapping memberships and retest the live app after publishing.
sections.zh: 成员可手动分配，也可按用户属性入组。通过条件加入的用户不能直接手动移除，需要修改条件。用户组变更需发布后生效，应检查重叠成员并在发布后复测正式应用。

sections.title_en: Supply real sample events in a disposable setup
sections.title_zh: 在可丢弃环境提供真实样例事件
sections.en: Event-based workflow testing needs an actual sample event, such as a form submission or record update. Some flow controls, including branching and filtering, do not support test preview. Test both resulting paths and inspect later action outputs before turning the workflow on; preview support alone is not full-flow validation.
sections.zh: 事件工作流测试需要真实样例事件，如表单提交或记录更新。分支、过滤等部分流程控制不支持测试预览。启用前应测试各条结果路径并检查后续动作输出，具备预览不等于全流程已验证。

sections.title_en: Keep branches, filters and loops distinct
sections.en: Branch provides yes/no paths; Filter stops an unwanted case without a second path. Loops execute contained actions once per item, so nested loops multiply work and action usage. Restrict input records early and use named prior-step outputs for subsequent actions to make failures and consumption easier to diagnose.
sections.zh: Branch 提供是／否两条路径，Filter 在不满足条件时直接停止。循环对每个项目执行内部动作，嵌套循环会放大工作量及动作消耗。应尽早限制输入记录，用明确的前序输出映射后续动作，便于诊断失败和用量。

sections.en: Studio supports live preview, role simulation and device sizing. Publishing exposes the app on the web, and later app changes require republishing. Verify anonymous and authenticated access on the published URL, then repeat the critical role tests whenever membership or data rules change.
sections.zh: Studio 支持实时预览、角色模拟和设备尺寸测试。发布使应用可通过网页访问，后续应用改动需要重新发布。应在正式 URL 检查匿名及登录访问，成员或数据规则变化后重新测试关键角色。
